node: Advanced-package substrates and upstream substrate materials
summary: Expanded the universe for the advanced-package substrate and upstream materials node with a deliberately underfollowed lens. The strongest US-listed discovery candidates are not finished substrate makers, but specialty chemistry, plating, surface treatment, and inspection/metrology vendors that may influence FC-BGA, IC substrate, RDL, copper adhesion, plating uniformity, and yield. Reference context from the supplied research notes says the deepest chokepoints may sit beneath substrate makers: Ajinomoto in build-up insulating film and MEC Company in copper-bonding surface chemistry. Because those are not clean US-listed small/mid-cap chip plays, the US-listed hunting lane shifts toward Element Solutions, MKS/Atotech, Camtek, and DuPont as public proxies. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
